Highland District Hospital utilizes savings generated through the 340B Drug Pricing Program to strengthen access to healthcare services and improve affordability for the patients and communities we serve.

As a rural Critical Access Hospital, 340B savings help offset the financial burden associated with caring for uninsured and underinsured patients, allowing Highland District Hospital to continue providing medically necessary services regardless of a patient's ability to pay.

Additionally, 340B program savings support the availability of specialty care services that would otherwise be difficult to sustain in a rural community. These resources help make services such as pulmonology, general surgery, neurology, oncology, and pain management available locally, reducing the need for patients to travel outside Highland County to receive specialty care. By supporting these service lines, the 340B program improves access to timely, high-quality care while strengthening the long-term financial sustainability of essential healthcare services within our community.

Highland District Hospital remains committed to using 340B program savings to expand access to care, reduce financial barriers for patients, and ensure that residents of Highland County have access to a broad range of healthcare services close to home.
